name: Complex_Convert_1
questiontext:
Consider the complex number \[z={{CT:0}} \] Evaluate the modulus of \(z\) \((r = |z|)\) and the principal value of the argument of \(z\) (\(\theta = \mathrm{Arg}(z)\)). Enter your results in the correct order, i.e. \([r,\theta]\).

 

\([r,\theta] = \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback: \[r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\] \[r=\sqrt{\left({{CT:1}}\right)^2+\left({{CT:2}}\right)^2}=\sqrt{{{CT:3}}+{{CT:4}}}\] \[r=\sqrt{{CT:5}}={{CT:6}}\] \[tan(\mathrm{arg}(z))=\frac{y}{x}=\frac{{CT:2}}{{CT:1}}={{CT:7}}\] \[\mathrm{arg}(z)={{CT:8}} + k\cdot\pi\] Considering the appropriate quadrant of the complex plane to fix \(k\), we find that \[\mathrm{arg}(z)={{CT:9}}\].
